notes.title: Club Bifrost Ver1.12a Update
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for a great launch week! The doors of Club Bifrost will continue to be open up for you!

There has been reports of Monster Girl Club Bifrost being falsely flagged by certain antivirus programs as a virus. As long as you downloaded all your files from Steam, the files should be safe as long as they are not modified! ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Please let your friends and their pet animals know that Monster Girl Club Bifrost is virus-free and available on Steam! And also check out our game catalog on our website at: https://remtairy.com/

Our next upcoming on Steam will be Island SAGA, developed by the lovely Kamichichi and also published and localized by us! Please wishlist Island SAGA on Steam after you finish writing a review for Club Bifrost! ːlovewaveː

And with that all said, here's the changelog for Club BIfrost v1.12a:

Changelog
[list]
[*]Fixed the game freezing when the clients get way too satisfied.
[*]Fixed the training buttons being grayed out even when the monster girl has stamina.
[*]Made the number animation go by a bit faster during Night Phase when the numbers are really high.
[*]Fixed a display error with club experience when clients extend their time.
[*]Made the maximum amount of Mood that can be gained during Night Phase to 100.
[*]Minor bugs and typos fixed.
[/list]

Please restart Steam to download the v1.12a update!

notes.title: Welcome to Monster Girl Club Bifrost! Worldwide release!
notes.notes:
Welcome dear client, to the newest Monster Girl Club in town! We have a wide range of monster girls to suit your exquisite tastes, from monster girls with wings, or with horns, or with tails to monster girls who are half or even a third of your size, or to ones who tower above you.

Monster Girl Club Bifrost is a strategy simulation game where you, as a debt ridden man, is in charge of training monster girls to prepare them for the nighttime when clients will arrive seeking respite in the arms of a lovely monster girl. Will you succeed in paying back your debt, fall in love with one of your own monster girl, or lose everything for failing to keep up with your debt payments?

Monster Girl Club Bifrost will have a launch discount sale for a week, so grab a copy for yourself and maybe even another copy for your friend or family so that they can stay safe at home in the comforts of Club Bifrost in these trying times! 

Check out our website for more information about Club Bifrost and our other games, and please follow us on social media to stay up to date! Stay safe, stay home with Club Bifrost! ːlovewaveː
